description_en: Calls the ConnectRouterInterface operation to initiate a connection from the requester VPC router interface to the accepter
description_zh: 调用ConnectRouterInterface接口由发起端路由器接口向接收端发起连接
kebab_example: aliyun vpc connect-router-interface --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-interface-id ri-2zeo3xzyf38r4urzd0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConnectRouterInterface

parameters.help_en:
The region where the router interface is located. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
路由器接口所在的地域。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
